statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-107929: when CURLOPT_INTERFACE (or --interface) is set with an if!, host! or ifhost! prefix, that binding is not part of the connection reuse key, so a later transfer asking for a different source can reuse the earlier connection and leave from the earlier source address. curl 8.9.0 to 8.22.0 are affected; 8.23.0 fixes it (also 8.14.3, 8.16.2 and 8.20.2 on older branches): https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-107929.html, https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/d37d79df1e01066417aff0a9e6bc675edad3edba, contained in the curl-8_23_0 release tag and not in curl-8_22_0. Unpacked every published curl package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64, as curl, libcurl, curl-dev, curl-static, curl-dbg, curl-doc, curl-fish-completion and curl-zsh-completion. Their programs and shared libraries are the curl program and the libcurl.so.4 shared library, both dynamically linked against musl. libcurl links OpenSSL, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2, libidn2, libpsl, zstd and brotli; 8.17.0-r1 and 8.18.0-r0 also link nghttp3; no ELF file links an SSH library (libssh2, libssh or wolfSSH), an LDAP library or GnuTLS. curl-static ships the static libcurl.a, whose members are all libcurl's own object files; curl-dbg holds only detached debug information for curl and libcurl. No package contains a PE or Mach-O file. The libcurl.so.4 in each build reports the curl release of its package version. Builds 8.17.0-r1 to 8.22.0-r0 package curl 8.17.0 to 8.22.0 releases, inside the affected range; 8.23.0-r0 and later package curl 8.23.0, and Alpine's curl APKBUILD lists this CVE under its 8.23.0-r0 secfixes (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/856d76205ed1b7f875d32fd7b72eb93912f32acd/main/curl/APKBUILD). The range ends at 8.23.0-r0.
